# TJA Renderer

From [jack9966qk/TJARenderer](https://github.com/jack9966qk/TJARenderer) at commit `2a3a7e4`, under the
MIT License in `LICENSE`.

Changed here:

- Every file starts with `// @ts-nocheck`: the code is written for a laxer tsconfig than this app's.
- `tja-parser.ts`: a long note's start written again before its end goes on with it
  (`joinRepeatedLongNoteStarts`), so a kusudama marked twice is one kusudama, as in the game.
- `renderer.ts` and `layout.ts`: under "TJA renderer by Jack", the credit adds a line for this copy's
  maintainer, "Enhanced by HicirTech/腋毛科技", and the layout keeps room for it.
